Package com.recruitment.model

Class User

java.lang.Object
com.recruitment.model.User
public class User extends Object
Domain model representing a registered user in the recruitment system.

Users may be teaching assistants (User.Role.TA), module organisers (User.Role.MO), or administrators (User.Role.ADMIN). TA-specific profile data includes skills, CV file path, and contact details; MO users may have an associated department. Credentials and identifiers are persisted via users.json.
